$95,000 - $145,000 a year - Contract

This is an opportunity to explore future QA Engineer positions where you would take ownership of testing strategy, quality metrics, and defect management across regulated product development. Roles of this type typically involve hands-on test automation, compliance validation, and collaboration with engineering and product teams to ensure delivery excellence.

Please note the content of this advert does not represent a live vacancy.

About the opportunity

You could be joining teams focused on quality assurance and testing validation in a dynamic, collaborative environment. Roles of this type may involve working within a quality management system (QMS) framework, managing test cycles, designing automated test strategies, and ensuring products meet regulatory and compliance standards. The work could span test planning, execution, defect tracking, and quality metrics reporting—with opportunities to influence testing approaches and raise quality standards across delivery teams.

Typical role overview

  • Location: Boston, Massachusetts, USA
  • Type: Permanent · Full-time
  • Salary: $95,000 - $145,000 per annum
  • Domain: Quality assurance · testing · compliance validation

What you would do

Typical responsibilities could include:

  • Developing and executing comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts across product lifecycle phases
  • Designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Jira, and QMS platforms
  • Managing defect identification, documentation, and tracking through the full resolution cycle
  • Collaborating with engineering, product, and operations teams to ensure quality standards are met
  • Executing compliance validation and regulatory testing where required
  • Analyzing and reporting quality metrics to support data-driven decision-making
  • Contributing to continuous improvement of testing methodologies and automation capabilities

What you could bring

Most roles of this type require the following:

Must-have

  • 2–5 years' hands-on experience in QA testing, quality assurance, or test automation
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, QMS platforms, and defect management systems such as Jira
  • Working knowledge of test planning, test case design, and defect management processes
  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory validation frameworks
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
  • Authorization to work in the United States

Nice-to-have

  • ISTQB Certified Tester, ISTQB Advanced Tester, or equivalent certification (CSTE, CTAE, Selenium Certification)
  • Experience with multiple test automation frameworks or languages
  • Background in regulated industries (medical device, pharmaceutical, or aerospace)
  • Experience mentoring junior testers or contributing to QA process improvement

What roles of this type could offer

Most roles of this type offer the following, dependent on the industry and seniority of the role:

  • Hands-on involvement in delivering quality products with direct impact on user outcomes
  • Scope to develop test automation expertise and quality methodology skills
  • Potential progression toward senior QA or QA leadership roles, where supported by the role facts
  • Collaborative, learning-focused team environment with structured development opportunities
  • Comprehensive package elements including health coverage, paid time off, 401(k), flexible compensation, and remote flexibility where available
